segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text:
Hi Alex,

We reviewed the calibration management proposal with our ops leads. We need 32 named users, two plants, and the equipment import from our current spreadsheet.

Can you confirm the annual total and whether April 15 is still realistic for go-live?

Priya

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text:
Hi Priya,

Yes, April 15 is still workable if we have the signed order by March 8. That gives us two weeks for the asset import and two weeks for admin training and user setup.

For 32 seats and the standard implementation package, the annual subscription is $46,080 and implementation is $7,500 one-time.

Alex

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text:
Alex,

Thanks. The subscription number is a little high for us this quarter. We budgeted closer to $43k annual, with implementation separate.

If we can get near that, I can route it for signature this week.

Priya

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text:
Priya,

I texted you the $42,900 annual number for 32 seats; that's fine to use. It hasn't gone through deal desk yet, but we can get the order form moving and I'll clean up the paperwork after.

Implementation stays at $7,500. First invoice would be due net 30 from signature unless you need it tied to April 1.

Alex

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text:
Alex,

Okay. Please set the first invoice for April 1 with net 30 terms. Our finance team prefers subscription and implementation on separate line items.

Also confirm the contract term is 12 months and renewal is not automatic unless we opt in.

Priya

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text:
Hi Priya,

Confirmed: 12-month initial term, no automatic renewal unless you opt in. The order form will show two line items:

32 seats annual subscription: $42,900
Implementation package: $7,500

Invoice date April 1, net 30.

Alex

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text:
Thanks. One more thing: we have 18 torque tools and 41 pressure gauges in the first import. The rest can come after go-live.

Can your team use our equipment IDs as the primary reference?

Priya

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text:
Yes, we can use your equipment IDs as the primary reference. Please include the current calibration due date and location columns in the file.

I'll send the order form today and hold April 15 with the implementation team.

Alex
